title: Norse Atlantic Airways files for bankruptcy and cancels all future flights
summary_full: Norwegian airline tells customers not to come to airports after surging fuel costs caused by Iran war ruin financesNorse Atlantic Airways has filed for bankruptcy and cancelled all future flights after surging fuel costs caused by the Iran war ruined its finances.The Norwegian airline said it was entering insolvency and posted a message on its website telling customers not to come to airports – including passengers stranded away from home. Its collapse came a day after it put flights on hold with a warning that its finances were critical. Continue reading...
